content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm working on what should be a straightforward task but I'm not seeing progress. I'm using a mathematical formula to reference two timer values through VM mapping, with an analog ramp serving as a pass-through. My goal is to add the two values together and show the total using a data window on the display. I've attempted various methods, yet the result always shows zero. Over the past year, I've realized there are multiple ways to program for the same outcome—some approaches are smoother than others, but ultimately the results match. As usual, any assistance is greatly appreciated.
You need to invert the enable input of the block B071. Alternatively, you can connect the enable input to a high (HI) block.
That makes sense—I overlooked keeping things simple. Thanks a lot for your help.
